main.description: Pointer-only echo written into a domain PDS that references a canonical fact record living in the master/owning repo. The echo carries no payload, only the coordinates needed to fetch the fact.

domain.description: Constitutional domain, e.g. social, commerce, media, arcade, tezos, ops, os.

refKind.description: Short kind tag, e.g. post, reaction, media, profile.

factType.description: The $type of the referenced canonical record.

factRepo.description: DID of the repo holding the canonical record.
